title: Zebra waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Zebra body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='26' ry='17' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- Body stripes -->
  <path d='M30 50 Q34 62 30 76' stroke='#3a3f5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 47 Q45 60 42 78' stroke='#3a3f5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M55 46 Q57 60 55 79' stroke='#3a3f5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M67 48 Q68 62 66 76' stroke='#3a3f5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='76' width='7' height='20' rx='3' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='42' y='76' width='7' height='20' rx='3' fill='#dcdcdc'/>
  <rect x='57' y='76' width='7' height='20' rx='3' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='68' y='76' width='7' height='20' rx='3' fill='#dcdcdc'/>
  <!-- Leg stripes -->
  <rect x='30' y='83' width='7' height='4' fill='#3a3f5c'/>
  <rect x='42' y='88' width='7' height='4' fill='#3a3f5c'/>
  <rect x='57' y='83' width='7' height='4' fill='#3a3f5c'/>
  <rect x='68' y='88' width='7' height='4' fill='#3a3f5c'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <rect x='42' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <rect x='57' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <rect x='68' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d='M74 50 L88 26 L82 22 L68 44 Z' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <path d='M76 46 L88 24' stroke='#3a3f5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 42 L80 30' stroke='#3a3f5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='87' cy='20' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <path d='M81 14 Q85 18 81 22' stroke='#3a3f5c' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M89 13 Q93 17 89 21' stroke='#3a3f5c' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='95' cy='24' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#d9b6a0'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='88' cy='18' r='2' fill='#2b2f4a'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <path d='M82 11 L79 3 L86 8 Z' fill='#f2f2f2' stroke='#3a3f5c' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M90 10 L92 2 L95 9 Z' fill='#f2f2f2' stroke='#3a3f5c' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Mane -->
  <path d='M78 12 L72 6 L76 16 L68 12 L73 20 L65 18 L71 26' stroke='#3a3f5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Raised waving arm -->
  <path d='M66 56 Q70 44 76 34' stroke='#e8e8e8' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <rect x='72' y='28' width='10' height='9' rx='4' fill='#e8e8e8' transform='rotate(30 77 32)'/>
  <path d='M73 30 L74 36 M77 28 L78 34 M81 29 L81 35' stroke='#3a3f5c' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M25 58 Q16 54 14 62' stroke='#3a3f5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#3a3f5c'/>
</svg>
